id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20b4: Shiver... I'm scared. Scary people. Go away...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20bf: Listening to the waves, I remember a fish fairy tale from when I was little.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20cb: A kingdom of beautiful fish... deep, deep down. I-I'd like to go once.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20da: I... like festivals. Fun. They remind me of being a kid.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|210d: That man was a soldier of the Bandelfon kingdom, burned down long ago, they say. Losing the country he'd return to is sad.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|211d: Bandelfon is on the continent far to the northeast by ship. Now it's probably just a pile of rubble.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|212f: In the northeast there once flourished a rich kingdom named Bandelfon, but monsters burned it to the ground.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|213f: Rumor says the Darkspawn was behind that too, but it was long ago. Nobody knows the truth.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|214f: For such a big festival, even in my room I can hear the cheering. I should go take a look soon.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21a7: Hmm... when you put it like that I waver, but I'm in no position to buy something that expensive.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b2: Not something man-made... Now I want natural, living motifs like nature or animals.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21c3: ...Huh, who are you? Barging into my studio without permission. How rude.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21e9: I'd love to walk the festival's main street and blow off steam, but my maid won't allow it.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2213: Hm, still here? ...Come to think of it, you resemble someone.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2219: Or maybe it's my imagination. ...Now, out of my way! Out, out!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b6: My master's paintings used to sell, but now they hardly do. He's what you'd call a one-hit painter.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22e8: If my hard-working master starts slacking, my pay suffers. I'd be glad if you left.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22fc: My master the painter was in a long slump, but after years he's finally had some inspiration.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2307: ...Perhaps now my unpaid wages will finally be paid. Honestly, what a needy man.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23ac: Mayor Rotondo's son Placido isn't well. I must cook him something nutritious.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23cd: ...What? The mayor's mansion? Cross the bridge right there to the east, and that's Mayor Rotondo's mansion.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23ec: For Master Rotondo, so kind to everyone, to chase a guest away, that person must have been extremely rude.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23fa: ...Come to think of it, with that silky hair, you match a description I've heard. Hmm, where did I hear it?

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|241a: General Jasper is sharp and handsome, so he has many fans, but I always thought he was unpleasant!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2429: Doing that to young master Placido is outrageous! I bet he's plotting evil behind the scenes!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|245f: There's a huge ship at the dock. It seems to belong to the traveling entertainer Sylvando.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2468: Only a handful of people in the world can buy a ship like that. I'll never afford one. I'm envious.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2478: Your companions were shopping upstairs. They were gawking at the stalls, so they must be country folk.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2488: Hm? Did I see two boys together? ...There's a pretty blond kid over there, but no boys. Sorry I can't help.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2497: Anyway, why not enjoy the festival? Lots of people are gathered in the square!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24a7: I hear you're being chased as the Darkspawn. Rotondo told everyone and is keeping you secret from the soldiers.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24b4: But being chased by General Jasper himself... What did you do...?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|251a: Oh, sorry. The shop is still getting ready.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2521: We'll open with a big splash when the Mighty Man Contest is held, so come shop then.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2533: Oh, sorry, customer! We're not ready and can't sell anything! We'll open before the contest starts!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2545: Honestly, what's with everyone? They didn't even put their stall goods away before scurrying off.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2550: In times like this, fleeing in a panic does no good. Staying calm and composed is the safest. Don't they get it?

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2570: Well, I'll prepare leisurely until the next one.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2597: The town's traditional event, the Mighty Man Contest, is coming up. I've decided to open a shop at last.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a6: But opening without a plan will just bring silence. I wish I had a good idea to win the stall war...

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25c4: ...Oh, west of town? I was born and raised here and never heard of that cave.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25d6: Welcome! I'm new this year, but I thought hard to win this sales battle and have a special headline item!

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2607: Ha ha, just kidding! Don't take it seriously! Just some mighty man humor!

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2645: Yeah, go for it! That's a mighty man for you!

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2675: I saw Rad being chased by a girl in a red hood. Did he pull another prank?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2681: Rad once walked the ropes linking the roofs and caused a huge fuss. He's such a troublemaker.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2691: Troublemaker Rad has started helping his father. Children grow up so fast.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26bd: I know a skilled merchant who got a treasure in Gallopolis and left town in high spirits.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26ca: What, where did he go? Hmm, I don't know that far.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d6: Every time the Mighty Man Contest is held, countless stalls line up and the place is packed...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26e3: This year is livelier than ever! Maybe the whole world has heard of the Mighty Man Contest!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26f6: Come to think of it, that merchant who got the Gallopolis treasure longed to build a house in Puerto Valor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2705: Puerto Valor is famous as a summer retreat. Building a house there is everyone's dream at least once.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|273b: I recently saw a merchant carrying a branch that shone in vivid colors. I'd never seen such a strange branch.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2794: I recently saw a merchant carrying a branch that shone in vivid colors. I'd never seen such a strange branch.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|274a: I hear that merchant took a ship to another continent.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a3: I hear that merchant took a ship to another continent.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2758: A little girl in a red hood just ran toward the small lighthouse chasing a boy. It was heartwarming.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2768: At that age I used to play tag around here with the neighborhood kids too.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2778: Every year, mighty men come from far countries to enter the contest.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2782: This year a man named Mr. Han is coming from a place called Grotto. I wonder what he's like.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27da: When I was small, my parents were killed by monsters. I was taught it was the Darkspawn's fault.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27e9: If the Darkspawn shows up in this town, I'll catch him to learn the truth! That's why I keep patrolling today.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27fd: The whole town's in on this festival, so I can't sit still. I'm helping prepare for the contest too.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2820: Y-you! Darkspawn! My parents were killed by monsters you controlled!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|282b: I'll protect this town! I won't let you through here!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2839: I was raised to believe my parents were killed by monsters made vicious by the Darkspawn...

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2857: ...But then who made the monsters vicious? Is there some other evil out there...?

tm.「こうして 仕事終わりに\n ダーハルーネで獲れた 新鮮な魚を料理して\n 一杯: After work, I like cooking fresh Gondolia fish and having a drink.

tm.「に 逃げたりして 悪かった！\n 頼むから 見逃してくれ～っ！: Sorry for running away! Please, let me off!
tm.「そろそろ デルカダールからの船が\n 到着する予定なんだが\n まだ 影も形も: The ship from Heliodor should arrive any time now, but there's no sign of it yet.

tm.「不思議です…… ああ 不思議です。\n なぜ 今日は こんなにも人が多いのか…: How mysterious... oh, how mysterious. Why are there so many people today? There seem to be more shops too.

tm.「しかし 海の男コンテストがあると\n なぜ 人が増えて 店も増えるのか。\n: But why does a contest bring more people and shops? How mysterious... oh, how mysterious.
tm.「考えごとに夢中で 気づかなかったのですが\n なにやら 騒がしい 雰囲気ですね: I was so absorbed in thought I didn't notice, but it seems noisy somehow...

tm.「あの魔物が あれほど 町に近づいてくるなんて\n 何かが 海に起こっているのか: For it to come this close to town, something may be happening in the sea. How mysterious, oh how mysterious...
tm.「ガクガク…………。\n オレ こわい 人 こわい。\n あっち 行け……。: Shiver... I'm scared. Scary people. Go away...
tm.「オレ 波の音を聞いていると 思いだす。\n 子供の頃に聞いた 魚の おとぎ話。: Listening to the waves, I remember a fish fairy tale from when I was little.
tm.「キレイな 魚たちの王国……。\n 深い 深い所に あるという。\n オ……オレ: A kingdom of beautiful fish... deep, deep down. I-I'd like to go once.
tm.「オレ…… お祭り 楽しくて す…好き。\n 子供の頃を お…思いだす。: I... like festivals. Fun. They remind me of being a kid.
tm.「そこにいる男は 昔 焼き滅ぼされた\n バンデルフォン王国の兵士だったとか……: That man was a soldier of the Bandelfon kingdom, burned down long ago, they say. Losing the country he'd return to is sad.
tm.「バンデルフォン王国は ここから北東へ\n ずっと 船を進めた大陸に あります。: Bandelfon is on the continent far to the northeast by ship. Now it's probably just a pile of rubble.
tm.「かつて 北東の大陸には バンデルフォンという\n 豊かな王国が 栄華を誇ってい: In the northeast there once flourished a rich kingdom named Bandelfon, but monsters burned it to the ground.
tm.「それも 悪魔の子が黒幕というウワサですが\n もう だいぶ前の話……。\n 真: Rumor says the Darkspawn was behind that too, but it was long ago. Nobody knows the truth.
tm.「大規模な お祭りだけあって\n 部屋の中まで にぎわう声が聞こえてきますよ。\: For such a big festival, even in my room I can hear the cheering. I should go take a look soon.
tm.「う～ん……そこまで言われると\n ボクも 心がグラつくけど\n そんな高いモノ: Hmm... when you put it like that I waver, but I'm in no position to buy something that expensive.
tm.「そういう 人が作ったモノじゃなくて……。\n 今は 自然物とか 動物とか そう: Not something man-made... Now I want natural, living motifs like nature or animals.
tm.「……おや なんだい キミは？\n ボクのアトリエに 無断で入ってくるなんて\n: ...Huh, who are you? Barging into my studio without permission. How rude.
tm.「……まっ 特別に 大目に見てあげよう。\n なにせ ボクは 今 スランプ中でね: ...Well, I'll let it slide this once. I'm in a slump, you see. I can't get any work done. Ha ha ha.
tm.「うう～ん なんだい キミは？\n 今 新作の画を描くために\n アイデアを ね: Mmm, who are you? I'm kneading ideas for my new painting.
tm.「本当は お祭り中の大通りを歩いて\n パア～ッっと 息抜きをしたいんだけどね。: I'd love to walk the festival's main street and blow off steam, but my maid won't allow it.
tm.「この前 ホメロス将軍に追われる 青年を見て\n 追われる勇者というテーマを ひ: Seeing a young man chased by General Jasper gave me an idea: the hunted Luminary! A sure masterpiece!
tm.「さあ ジャマだ ジャマだ！\n 出てった 出てった！: Now out of my way! Out, out!
tm.「ムムッ まだ いたのかい。\n ……そういえば キミ 誰かに似てるな。: Hm, still here? ...Come to think of it, you resemble someone.
tm.「いや 気のせいかな。\n ……さあ ジャマだ ジャマだ！\n 出てった 出てっ: Or maybe it's my imagination. ...Now, out of my way! Out, out!
tm.「ご主人さまの画は かつて 売れてたけど\n 今は めっきり 売れなくなったわ…: My master's paintings used to sell, but now they hardly do. He's what you'd call a one-hit painter.
tm.「あら 昔の財産を食いつぶして 暮らしている\n いっぱつ屋のご主人さまに ご用: Oh, you want my master, the one-hit painter living off his old fortune? Sorry, he's working now.
tm.「せっかく 仕事をしているご主人さまが\n なまけ始めると 私の給料にも影響しま: If my hard-working master starts slacking, my pay suffers. I'd be glad if you left.
tm.「画家である ご主人さまは\n 長らく スランプが続いていたのですが\n 数年ぶ: My master the painter was in a long slump, but after years he's finally had some inspiration.
tm.「……これで 私の未払いの給料も\n やっと 支払われることでしょう。\n まっ: ...Perhaps now my unpaid wages will finally be paid. Honestly, what a needy man.
tm.「なんだか 町長ラハディオさまのご子息……\n ヤヒムぼっちゃんの体調が すぐれ: Mayor Rotondo's son Placido isn't well. I must cook him something nutritious.
tm.「ラハディオさまのご子息 ヤヒムぼっちゃんに\n 栄養をつけられるお料理を 考え: I'm thinking up nutritious dishes for Mayor Rotondo's son Placido. What menu would please him?
tm.「……え？ ラハディオさまのお屋敷ですって？\n すぐそこの橋を 東に渡ったとこ: ...What? The mayor's mansion? Cross the bridge right there to the east, and that's Mayor Rotondo's mansion.
tm.「ついさっき ラハディオさまが\n ご来客の方を 追いはらってたように見えたけど: I thought I just saw Master Rotondo chasing off a visitor. What on earth happened...?
tm.「あの 誰にでも優しい ラハディオさまが\n ご来客の方を 追いはらうだなんて…: For Master Rotondo, so kind to everyone, to chase a guest away, that person must have been extremely rude.
tm.「……そういえば あなた そのサラサラ髪といい\n なんだか 聞いた覚えのある特: ...Come to think of it, with that silky hair, you match a description I've heard. Hmm, where did I hear it?
tm.「あなた そのサラサラ髪といい\n なんだか 聞いた覚えのある特徴をしてるわね。: With that silky hair, you match a description I've heard. Hmm, where did I hear it?
tm.「ホメロス将軍は 切れ者で かっこいいから\n ファンも多いみたいだけど……私は: General Jasper is sharp and handsome, so he has many fans, but I always thought he was unpleasant!
tm.「ヤヒムぼっちゃんを あんな目にあわせるなんて\n とんでもないヤツよ！ 私の思: Doing that to young master Placido is outrageous! I bet he's plotting evil behind the scenes!
tm.「ドックに ドデカイ船が置いてあってさ。\n どうも 旅芸人シルビアの 所有物な: There's a huge ship at the dock. It seems to belong to the traveling entertainer Sylvando.
tm.「あんな スゴイ船を買える人なんて\n 世界でも ひと握りだろうなあ。\n 俺は: Only a handful of people in the world can buy a ship like that. I'll never afford one. I'm envious.
tm.「アンタの連れなら この上で 買い物してたよ。\n 露店を見て めずらしがってた: Your companions were shopping upstairs. They were gawking at the stalls, so they must be country folk.
tm.「え？ 男の子のふたり組を見なかったかって？\n ……金髪のキレイなコなら そこ: Hm? Did I see two boys together? ...There's a pretty blond kid over there, but no boys. Sorry I can't help.
tm.「まあ そんなことよりも\n お祭りを楽しんでいったら どうだい？\n 広場にゃ: Anyway, why not enjoy the festival? Lots of people are gathered in the square!
tm.「あんた 悪魔の子として 追われてるんだとな。\n ラハディオさんから みんなに: I hear you're being chased as the Darkspawn. Rotondo told everyone and is keeping you secret from the soldiers.
tm.「しかし あの将軍ホメロスに 追われるなんて\n あんたは いったい 何をしでか: But being chased by General Jasper himself... What did you do...?
tm.「あら ごめんなさいね。\n お店は まだ 準備中なのよ。: Oh, sorry. The shop is still getting ready.
tm.「海の男コンテストが開かれる時には\n パアッと 派手に 開店する予定だから\n: We'll open with a big splash when the Mighty Man Contest is held, so come shop then.
tm.「あらま お客さん ごめんよっ！\n まだ準備ができてなくて 何も売れないんだ！: Oh, sorry, customer! We're not ready and can't sell anything! We'll open before the contest starts!
tm.「……まったく なんだい みんな。\n 露店の商品も 片付けないで\n スタコラ: Honestly, what's with everyone? They didn't even put their stall goods away before scurrying off.
tm.「こんな時は あわてて逃げたって 仕方ないさ。\n 落ち着きはらって ドーンと: In times like this, fleeing in a panic does no good. Staying calm and composed is the safest. Don't they get it?
tm.「やれやれ 露店を準備してる間に\n 悪魔の子が 現れちゃってさ。\n 結局 何: Ugh, the Darkspawn showed up while I was setting up my stall. I couldn't sell a thing.
tm.「まあ また次回の開催まで\n のんびり 準備することにするかねえ。: Well, I'll prepare leisurely until the next one.
tm.「海の男コンテストっていう 町の伝統行事が\n 今度 開かれるんだけどよ。\n: The town's traditional event, the Mighty Man Contest, is coming up. I've decided to open a shop at last.
tm.「でも 考えなしに開いても カンコドリが\n 鳴くだけさ。露店争いに 勝ち残れる: But opening without a plan will just bring silence. I wish I had a good idea to win the stall war...
tm.「あんたら 連れだって どっかに行くのかい？\n ……ん？ 霊水の洞くつだって？: Are you two going somewhere together? ...What, the Spirit Water Cave? Where on earth is that?
tm.「……へえ～ この町の西にあるのか。\n 俺は この町で 生まれ育ったけど\n: ...Oh, west of town? I was born and raised here and never heard of that cave.
tm.「いらっしゃい！ オレは 今年からの新参者だが\n この商戦に負けないために 必: Welcome! I'm new this year, but I thought hard to win this sales battle and have a special headline item!
tm.「ふふ…それはな 海の男コンテストにちなんで\n この海の男のオレを 商品として: Heh... in honor of the Mighty Man Contest, I'm putting myself up as the product! A one-of-a-kind limited item! Buy?
tm.「なんだよ 残念だなあ！\n 自分で言うのも なんだが\n 若くて かっこよくて: Aw, too bad! I say so myself, but I'm young, handsome, and a bargain!
tm.「わははっ お客さん 冗談だよ！\n 真に受けないでくれ！\n たんなる 海の男: Ha ha, just kidding! Don't take it seriously! Just some mighty man humor!
tm.「げげっ……。こんな所に ゴンドラが！\n 悪魔の子に 見つかったら\n 逃げら: Uh-oh... a gondola here! If the Darkspawn spots it, he'll get away...
tm.「わわっ！ 悪魔の子っ！？\n お…お願いだ！ なんでもするから\n 命だけは: Waah! The Darkspawn?! P-please! I'll do anything, just spare my life!
tm.「そこにある ゴンドラは\n 好きに使っていいから 命だけは 助けてくれ！\n: Use that gondola however you like, just spare my life! Please! Okay? Okay?
tm.「よっ いいぞ～っ！\n さすがは 海の男～っ！: Yeah, go for it! That's a mighty man for you!
tm.「屋根をつなぐ ロープが見えるでしょう？\n 以前 宿屋さんの子供の ラッドくん: See the ropes linking the roofs? The innkeeper's son Rad once walked a tightrope on them and caused an uproar.
tm.「最近は おとなしくしているようだけど……\n ヤンチャ者で有名な ラッドくんの: He seems calm lately, but Rad's famously mischievous, so I worry he'll do something dangerous again.
tm.「ラッドくんが 赤いずきんの女の子に\n 追いかけられてるのを 見かけたけど……: I saw Rad being chased by a girl in a red hood. Did he pull another prank?
tm.「この前は ラッドくんが 屋根をつなぐロープを\n 綱渡りして 大騒ぎになったこ: Rad once walked the ropes linking the roofs and caused a huge fuss. He's such a troublemaker.
tm.「あの ヤンチャ者だったラッドくんが\n お父さんの手伝いを するようになったそ: Troublemaker Rad has started helping his father. Children grow up so fast.
tm.「知り合いに ウデのいい商人がいるんですがね。\n なんでも サマディーで 秘宝: I know a skilled merchant who got a treasure in Gallopolis and left town in high spirits.
tm.「え？ どこに行ったか 知らないかって？\n ……う～ん そこまでは わかりませ: What, where did he go? Hmm, I don't know that far.
tm.「海の男コンテストが 開かれる時は\n 毎度 たくさんの露店が 立ち並んで\n: Every time the Mighty Man Contest is held, countless stalls line up and the place is packed...
tm.「今年は 例年以上の 盛り上がりです！\n 世界の人々に 海の男コンテストのこと: This year is livelier than ever! Maybe the whole world has heard of the Mighty Man Contest!
tm.「そういえば サマディーの秘宝を入手した\n 私の知り合いの商人は ソルティコの: Come to think of it, that merchant who got the Gallopolis treasure longed to build a house in Puerto Valor.
tm.「ソルティコの町は 避暑地として有名でしてね。\n あの町に 家を建てることは\: Puerto Valor is famous as a summer retreat. Building a house there is everyone's dream at least once.
tm.「最近 色あざやかに かがやく\n 木の枝を抱えた商人を 見たんだ。\n あんな: I recently saw a merchant carrying a branch that shone in vivid colors. I'd never seen such a strange branch.
tm.「聞いた話によると その商人は\n 船で よその大陸に 向かったみたいだね。: I hear that merchant took a ship to another continent.
tm.「さっき 赤いずきんをかぶった 小さな女の子が\n 男の子を追って 小灯台の方へ: A little girl in a red hood just ran toward the small lighthouse chasing a boy. It was heartwarming.
tm.「私も あのくらいの頃は\n 近所の子供たちと 一緒になって\n この辺りで 追: At that age I used to play tag around here with the neighborhood kids too.
tm.「毎年 コンテストへ参加するために\n 遠い国から 海の男たちがやってくるんだ。: Every year, mighty men come from far countries to enter the contest.
tm.「今年は なんでも グロッタの町という所から\n ミスター・ハンという男が 来て: This year a man named Mr. Han is coming from a place called Grotto. I wonder what he's like.
tm.「まだ ボクが小さかった頃に\n 両親は魔物に襲われて 命を落とした……。\n: When I was small, my parents were killed by monsters. I was taught it was the Darkspawn's fault.
tm.「もしも この町に 悪魔の子が現れたら\n 本当のことを知るために 捕まえてやる: If the Darkspawn shows up in this town, I'll catch him to learn the truth! That's why I keep patrolling today.
tm.「今回のお祭りは 町をあげての行事だからね。\n こんな時に ジッとなんかしてら: The whole town's in on this festival, so I can't sit still. I'm helping prepare for the contest too.
tm.「この日くらいは 悪魔の子のことを忘れて\n お祭りに 参加したいと思ってるんだ: For one day, I want to forget the Darkspawn and join the festival. He wouldn't appear in a crowd like this!
tm.「や…やいっ 悪魔の子めっ！\n ボ ボクの両親は\n アンタに 操られた魔物に: Y-you! Darkspawn! My parents were killed by monsters you controlled!
tm.「この町は ボクが守るぞっ！\n ここは 絶対に通さないからな！: I'll protect this town! I won't let you through here!
tm.「ボクの両親は 悪魔の子に操られて\n 凶暴化した魔物たちによって 命を落とした: I was raised to believe my parents were killed by monsters made vicious by the Darkspawn...
tm.「ラハディオさんの話を 聞く限り\n 悪魔の子…勇者は いい人だったそうだし\n: But from what Rotondo says, the Darkspawn, the Luminary, was a good person. The rumors must have been wrong.
tm.「……でも だとしたら\n 一体 誰のせいで 魔物が凶暴化したんだろう？\n 邪: ...But then who made the monsters vicious? Is there some other evil out there...?
tm.「今度 世界中から いい男たちがやってくる\n 海の男コンテストっていう お祭り: Soon a festival called the Mighty Man Contest brings fine men from all over the world.
tm.「町の北側に 大きなステージがあるでしょう？\n そこで いい海の男たちが 立ち: See the big stage on the north side of town? The fine mighty men line up there. I can't wait!
